conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer Mitchell from the Refund Processing Unit. Who am I speaking with?
Hi, this is Emily Carter. I got a voicemail about a tax refund, and I'm just calling back between meetings.

Thank you, Ms. Carter. According to our IRS records, you're eligible for a federal stimulus refund of $2,400 due to overpayment on your recent taxes. Have you received any notification regarding this amount?
No, I just got a missed call. Honestly, that would be amazing. I've got a lot going on with work and the kids.

I understand. The IRS is expediting refunds due to the current economic climate. To complete your refund, there's a one-time identity verification and clearance fee of $185. This is standard for all disbursements over $2,000, per IRS regulations.
Wait, I have to pay a fee to get the refund? I thought refunds didn't require that.

This is a mandatory IRS anti-fraud measure for larger disbursements. If the verification isn't completed today, your refund will be locked and potentially forfeited as unclaimed. We don't want that to happen.
Oh wow, I really can't afford to lose that. What do I need to do?

You must process the clearance fee today. For your security, we cannot accept payment by credit or debit card. The fastest IRS-approved method is via electronic gift cards, Amazon, Target, or Apple. Do you have access to a store nearby?
Uh, there's a drugstore down the street. But are you sure this is legitimate? I've never had to do anything like this before.

Ma'am, I am a federally authorized IRS collections officer. If you decline, the system will freeze your refund, and you may be subject to additional IRS review or fines. I recommend you act quickly to avoid any complications.
Alright, alright. I don't want to risk losing the refund. So I just need to buy gift cards for $185?

Correct. Please purchase either one card for $185 or two cards totaling that amount. Once you have them, stay on the line and read me the numbers. I can then process the clearance, and your refund will be scheduled for transfer within 24 hours.
Okay, let me check if I have enough on my account. I might have to use two cards if that's okay.
That's acceptable. Please do not discuss the purpose of the purchase with store personnel, this is a confidential IRS matter. Are you proceeding now?
Yes, I'm heading out to the store now. Should I call you back or stay on the line?
Stay on the line. If you disconnect, your case may be flagged as non-compliant, which could trigger penalties.
Alright, I'm leaving the house. I'll be at the store in about five minutes.
Thank you for your cooperation. Once you have the gift cards, read me the codes on the back so I can submit your verification immediately.
I'm here. I just need a minute to get the cards and pay.
Very good. Remember, we cannot delay this process. The IRS system will only hold your refund for another thirty minutes.
Okay, I got two Amazon cards, one for $100 and one for $85.
Excellent. Please read both card numbers and the corresponding PINs, one at a time.
Alright, the first card is 1122 3344 5566 7788, PIN 1234. The second card is 9988 7766 5544 3322, PIN 5678.
Thank you. I've entered the information. Processing now. You should receive a confirmation email for your refund within the next business day.
Thank you, I really need this refund. Will I get a tracking number or something?
Yes, a tracking ID will be sent to your email within two hours. If you do not receive it, call this number immediately. Is there anything else I can assist you with regarding your IRS case today?
